title: Shaggy
summary: SHAG'GY, 1. Rough with long hair or wool. About his shoulders hangs the shaggy skin. Dryden. 2. Rough; rugged; as the shaggy tops of hills. And throw the shaggy spoils about your shoulders. Addison.
